text:
maya_se: @here Brightleaf (customer) just submitted an onboarding request for Atlas-13B. They want a Dedicated endpoint, low latency (~<250ms p50), and we're seeing hallucination regressions after int8 quant in their quick test. They asked for priority triage — commercial customer, onboarding next week.

samir_infra: Can you drop the model artifacts and their quant logs? size, config, and the eval prompts they used. Also what's expected QPS?

maya_se: Uploaded link to S3: s3://brightleaf/atlas13b/ - includes fp16 checkpoint + customer quant trace (they used bitsandbytes int8). QPS ~30 rps, bursty.

eli_mleng: Quick summary of our local smoke: ran our standard onboard-eval set against fp16 and bitsandbytes int8. Results: latency p50 ~220ms fp16 -> 85ms int8, token/sec up ~2.6x. But factuality score (our knowledge-probe) dropped 3.7% absolute, and hallucination rate up on anecdotal prompts. Exact match down 1.8%.

eli_mleng: command used:
```
./run_eval.sh --model s3://brightleaf/atlas13b/fp16 --quant int8 --eval-set onboard-v2 --out results/int8-smoke.json
```

nina_research: :eyes: not great on factuality. Options: try GPTQ 4-bit (per-channel/group-wise), or hybrid quant where first N transformer layers stay fp16. Also consider K/V cache handling — int8 can worsen KV reconstruction.

chen_brightleaf: From customer side: they'd accept a small perf hit if output quality stabilizes. They prefer staying under 300ms p50. Also open to 4-bit if it keeps costs reasonable.

samir_infra: For canary we can reserve a small Dedicated pool (2 infer nodes) and route 5% traffic. We'll add fallback routing to fp16 if hallucination > threshold. Need an A/B config and rollout TTL.

eli_mleng: I'll run targeted hallucination/regression evals (100 proprietary prompts + LLM-eval) and quantify distribution shifts. ETA 12h.

nina_research: Also recommend running token-level logit-diff traces for a handful of failing prompts to see where int8 diverges. I can take that.

maya_se: Next steps: 1) eli run the evals and post artifacts; 2) nina do logit traces; 3) samir schedule canary and route policy; 4) product (me) sync with Chen end-of-day.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary/atlas13b-brightleaf -> dev-pool-2, 5% traffic, start 2024-05-03T09:00Z.

chen_brightleaf: Thanks everyone. We can pause customer-side int8 experiments until you confirm canary config.

eli_mleng: Posting initial eval summary: results attached (results/int8-hallucination.csv). Preliminary: 3 anchors where int8 diverges early in decoding; likely quantization of attention proj. Will try hybrid fp16 first 4 layers.

nina_research: If hybrid fixes it, we can update quant profile and re-run CI. If not, try GPTQ 4-bit with per-channel scales.

samir_infra: I'll prepare rollout JSON and a fallback policy: if factuality_drop >= 2.0% OR error-rate >= 1%, route to fp16.

maya_se: OK capturing all. I'll update the customer and schedule a quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:

chen_brightleaf: great, appreciate the fast turnaround.

eli_mleng: tagging this for triage board: #onboard-priority. Will post final numbers after the hybrid run (6-8h).
